instruction: A warehouse starts with 950 boxes. It then increases its stock by 13 percent, discarding any fractional box (rounded down). Then it ships exactly one third of the new stock, rounded to the nearest whole box. How many boxes does the warehouse have left? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
